  • Provide guidance and strategic vision with UARC's consortium members to develop compelling research proposals for RITA's sponsors.
  • Oversees laboratory budgets, projects, and resources
  • Develops and mentors laboratory personnel and leadership
  • Communicates and collaborates with sponsors, lab personnel, RITA leadership, consortium members, and the Howard University Research Community
  • Establishes and maintains a RITA Research Leadership Team that exemplifies integrity while nurturing excellence, diversity, and innovation
  • Develops and prioritizes long-range research directions in collaboration with the RITA Research Leadership Team
  • Determines research staffing requirements; provides for interviewing, hiring, and training new employees

Core Competencies

  • Exceptional leadership and organizational skills, with a strong background in AI/ML.
  • Proven experience in research management and collaboration with defense agencies.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and oral, with the ability to engage effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with large-scale, multiyear federal sponsored awards.

Minimum Requirements

  • A doctoral degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

  • Extensive experience in AI/ML research, preferably with a focus on applications in defense or related sectors.
  • Demonstrated leadership in managing research teams and projects, with a track record of successful collaboration and innovation.
  • Ability to gain a security clearance.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage large multimillion-dollar federal awards successfully

  • Experience migrating legacy Hadoop/Snowflake/Redshift to Lakehouse.
  • Familiarity with MLflow, Feature Store, and Databricks Model Serving.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Health Coach role at Inside Higher Ed .

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Function and Purpose

Basic Function : The purpose of this position is to evaluate and improve the health and wellness of clients. The position is responsible for the supervision of medical and clerical staff in collaboration with the Medical Director to maintain quality services and efficient operations.

Supervision

Responsible for orienting and training medical and clerical staff and assigning and reviewing their work. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over other positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks and reporting to a higher level on a formal basis.

Nature and Scope

Internal contacts include medical faculty, Faculty Practice Plan staff, HU/HUH staff, third party payers. External contacts include executive alumni, vendors/contractors, and general public and external agencies.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Guide clients toward optimal health within the continuum of chronic disease to well-being.
  • Facilitate client’s behavior change using mindfulness skills and motivational interviewing.
  • Counsel clients to assess their overall health and determine long-term goals.
  • Help clients develop strategies for achieving goals.
  • Collaborate with provider to ensure that strategies align with overall treatment plans.
  • Conduct one-on-one health coaching sessions by providing client education and instruction as directed by the provider.
  • Coordinate medical referrals from provider to specialists for clients with chronic comorbidities.
  • Maintain referral log/referral tracking system and distribute to the appropriate provider.
  • Record patients' medical history, vital statistics, and information such as test results in medical records.
  • Retrieve lab reports, dictations, and files and maintain orderly records.
  • Prepare treatment rooms for patient examinations, keeping the rooms neat and clean.
  • Authorize drug refills and provide prescription information to pharmacies.
  • Clean and sterilize instruments and dispose of contaminated supplies.
  • Prepare and administer immunizations and medications as directed by a provider.
  • Manage vaccine inventory for your clinic.
  • Order all necessary vaccines and medical supplies for the efficient operation of the clinic to ensure compliance with current healthcare regulations, medical laws, and high ethical standards.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records and documentation in accordance with grant guidelines and confidentiality requirements.
  • Assist in data collection and outcome measurement efforts, ensuring the timely and accurate reporting for grant effectiveness.
  • Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data in core performance measures that are most critical to the care and treatment of patients.
  • Monitor health and immunization status of clients to improve patient outcomes.
  • Supervise all medical and clerical staff to ensure adherence to policies, procedures, and standard systems.
  • Implement and supervise effective front office business processes, including liaison between the clinic and FPP administration to assist with closures of provider schedules and support the medical director in daily work and performance of staff.
  • Make recommendations for staff to receive appropriate training and support to perform job functions.
  • Keep leadership informed about staff performance.
  • Coordinate and oversee regular building maintenance and repairs.
  • Represent department appropriately and maintain effective relationships within the clinical enterprise including ancillary departments, HUH, Faculty Practice Plan Business Office, employers, and other key constituencies.
  • Performs other business duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Knowledge of supervisory practices and principles.
  • Skill in organizing work of self and others.
  • Ability to plan, organize, coordinate and prioritize work in situations with diverse demands.
  • Knowledge of personal computer and word-processing, database, spreadsheet, and presentation software.
  • Knowledge of clinic operations to perform administrative/clerical functions and requirements of the organization.
  • Knowledge of examination, diagnostic and treatment room procedures.
  • Knowledge of Medical Terminology.
  • Knowledge of common safety hazards and precautions to maintain a safe work environment.
  • Skill in assisting in a variety of treatments and medications as directed. Skill in taking vital signs.
  • Skill in maintaining records and recording test results.
  • Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with clients, medical staff, and the public.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to follow established priorities or procedures and deliver quality customer service.
  • Ability to use good judgment, make sound decisions and demonstrate tact and diplomacy.
  • Ability to maintain quality control standards.
  • Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with patients, employees, and the public.
  • Ability to communicate with people from various educational levels and backgrounds.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree and 1-3 years of related work experience. 8 years of related work experience in health coaching, wellness, or a related field (e.g., counseling, fitness, or healthcare) may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications. Relevant Experience: Certification from a recognized health coaching program (e.g., National Board for Health & Wellness Coaching, ACE, ICF) is required. Previous supervisory responsibility required.

$60,000-$70,000

description:
Overview

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. The Senior Software Engineer I, Unified Experience will be building and shaping our product for Private Equity clients, collaborating with business and engineering teams across domains including Cap Table Management and Fund administration.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. You will be one of the key contributors improving operational efficiency, building new features, and leveraging standardized solutions in a challenging product area.

The Team You'll Work With

The Unified Experience for PE team at Carta helps private equity firms easily see and manage their portfolio companies by creating connected and user-friendly tools. The team’s core focus is to create a unified experience for investors — including detailed views for PE-backed LLCs.

Some of the key problem areas you will be working on:

  • Fragmented experience - The platform lacks unified dashboards for all investment entities, especially PE-backed LLCs, making portfolio overviews difficult.
  • Missing Valuations and Insights - Key information (valuations, holdings, financials, KPIs) is not easily accessible for PE-backed LLCs and FA issuers, limiting transparency.
  • Cumbersome Entry to Key Products - No streamlined way to access essential tools (e.g., valuations, data monitoring) from portfolio views.
  • Disconnected Platform Workflows - Data and workflows across investments, valuation, and reporting aren’t well integrated—impacting product launches and analytics.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to design and deliver enterprise-grade features for the Unified Experience for PE.
  • Build and shape front-end and/or full-stack solutions using ReactJS, TypeScript, and related tooling.
  • Champion scalable architectures, SOA/microservices concepts, and data-driven approaches to improve user experience for Private Equity clients.
  • Engage with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing to deliver customer value and refine requirements.

About You

  • You deeply care about your users and are relentless in your pursuit to build enterprise-grade applications. You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively and can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally:
  • 5+ years of frontend or full-stack engineering experience.
  • Experience in architecting complex SaaS products with Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) and microservices.
  • Passion for elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, TypeScript, React Queries, Storybook, Amplitude, Ink).
  • Ability to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business, and marketing.
  • Interest in AI/ML technologies and how they can improve product experiences.
  • A desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to own your work end-to-end.
  • Willingness to move fast while building for the future.

Disclosures

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.

description:
ROLE PURPOSE

  • The Cost Optimization team is responsible for identifying cost reduction opportunities within Brazil Operations without compromising safety or service quality.
  • Brazil Operations is a critical business unit for SBM Offshore’s cash flow, handling 20-30% of Brazil’s oil production.
  • The cost structure of Brazil Operations is heavily focused on maintenance activities that ensure FPSOs (Floating Production Storage and Offloading units) can operate for up to 25 years in remote ocean locations, ensuring equipment reliability and the integrity of hulls and tanks.
  • The Senior Cost Controller will be a key player in this strategic initiative, requiring a blend of strategic vision and strong skills in modeling and data analysis.

RESPONSABILITIES

  • Understand the cost structure of Brazil Operations to identify areas of high expenditure within the P&L.

  • Identify and prioritize cost-reduction opportunities by assessing financial feasibility (business cases), developing projections/forecasts, and maximizing returns.

  • Lead or collaborate on cost-reduction projects with internal teams (e.g., Supply Chain, HR, Maintenance), providing critical analysis of both cost and performance data that impacts costs (e.g., productivity). This includes defining key performance indicators (KPIs), data gathering, insights generation, proposing improvements, and influencing business transformation.

  • Improve cost tracking processes by generating regular optimization reports using internal systems (e.g., ERP). Take responsibility for data from source to transformation, including dashboard creation and data flow automation. Ensure data consistency, quality, and governance, collaborating with IT.

  • Support communication initiatives to raise awareness among employees about the importance of cost management, linking it to the company’s long-term strategy.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related fields.

  • An MBA or a master’s degree in finance is highly desirable.

  • Solid experience in consulting, cost optimization, cost analysis, financial efficiency, corporate finance, financial modeling, project valuation, strategic planning, data intelligence, data analytics, business intelligence, or process optimization.

  • Fluent in both Portuguese and English (written and spoken).

  • Advanced Excel proficiency.

  • Experience with databases modeling tools (e.g., Access, Alteryx, Power Pivot/Power Query, ETL, Star Schema, OLAP, master data management, cubes, or similar), managing large datasets.

  • Basic knowledge in the following (no professional experience required):

    • SQL or any programming language.

    • Project valuation and business cases (e.g., ROI, NPV).

    • Key financial reports (balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow).

  • Basic knowledge of the Oil and Gas industry is desirable.

  • Familiarity with Maintenance Strategy and Integrity concepts is a plus.

title: Product Designer (Full-Time, SaaS Platform)
description:
Product Designer (Full-Time, SaaS Platform)

Join to apply for the Product Designer (Full-Time, SaaS Platform) role at FirstIgnite

Base pay range
$50,000.00/yr - $75,000.00/yr

About Us FirstIgnite is at the forefront of innovation, building a cutting-edge SaaS platform that bridges the gap between academia and industry through smart technology and AI-driven tools. Our platform empowers tech transfer offices, researchers, and decision-makers with actionable insights to commercialize high-potential inventions. As we expand and scale quickly, we’re looking for a dynamic, creative, and fast-moving Product Designer to join our growing team, shape the user experience, and evolve our product to meet the needs of our diverse user base. We prize simplicity, innovation, and collaboration, and if that excites you—we’d love to have you onboard.

The Role We are searching for an exceptional Product Designer to take ownership of the end-to-end design process for our SaaS platform. As our Product Designer, you’ll be juggling between ideation, prototyping, and refinement to bring elegant and intuitive experiences to life. In an environment where speed meets thoughtfulness, you’ll have the chance to move quickly while making meaningful contributions to key product decisions. This role isn’t just about pushing pixels—it’s about working closely with Product, Engineering, and Leadership to ensure that every decision improves the user experience, feels effortless, and aligns with the overall product vision as we continue building features at a blistering pace.

What You’ll Do

  • End-to-End Design: Own the entire design cycle—from brainstorming and research to delivering high-fidelity mockups, wireframes, prototypes, and additional specifications for engineering teams.
  • Collaborate Thoughtfully: Work with product managers, engineers, and leadership to collect feedback, iterate quickly, and guide conversations about feature direction and experience.
  • Design Intuitive and Modern Interfaces: Deliver sleek, functional, and visually stunning designs that elevate the user’s experience.
  • Fluent in English: Strong verbal and written communication skills are essential for collaborating with the team and stakeholders.
  • Rapid Prototyping: Translate ideas into fast and effective mockups for approval before extensive backend resources are allocated for development.
  • Platform Usability Improvements: Audit user workflows across the SaaS platform and recommend changes to improve core usability.
  • Front-End Familiarity: Have a basic working knowledge of front-end frameworks (Vue.js, Sass/SCSS, Bulma/Buefy) to create feasible designs while collaborating with developers on what's possible. Bonus if you can help refine and implement your own designs in the code!
  • Stay Agile: Work at speed to meet evolving project deadlines while maintaining high-quality designs that meet business objectives.
  • Push the Boundaries: Explore modern design technologies and solutions to keep our platform fresh and competitive.
  • Develop Design Systems: Evolve and maintain a scalable design system with reusable components for consistent styling across the tool.

Who You Are We’re looking for a Product Designer with a mix of creativity, technical fluency, and execution speed. You should thrive in a fast-paced environment, be obsessed with how great products feel and function, and have the strategic mind to assess what’s worth investing in and when.

Here’s Your Checklist

  • Proven Experience: 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Designer (or similar roles in SaaS/Product-focused environments with web platforms).
  • Design Portfolio: A rich set of sample designs showing intuitive interface designs, thoughtful workflows, design systems, prototypes, and processes that brought measurable success to a product.
  • Rapid Prototyping Skills: Ability to create both low-fidelity wireframes and pixel-perfect high-fidelity designs with a focus on speed and flexibility.
  • Modern Design Tools: Proficiency with Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Framer, or other preferred tools.
  • User-First Thinker: Deep understanding of user pain points, workflows, and human-centered design principles.
  • Familiarity with Front-End Frameworks: Working knowledge of Vue.js, SCSS, Bulma/Buefy or equivalent front-end principles to align design and development.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Quick to bounce ideas off team members and justify design decisions to non-design stakeholders.
  • Technical Exposure (Preferred): Basic coding skills (HTML/CSS/Vue.js) to bring designs to life on the platform.
  • Innovation-Seeker: Stay up to date on UX trends and SaaS practices to recommend emerging ideas.
  • Team Player with Ownership: Independent yet collaborative to build the best product together.
  • Detail-Oriented but Fast: Manage priorities and meet deadlines with accuracy and minimal back-and-forth.

Our Tech Stack We’re flexible. Our current stack includes Vue.js, Sass/SCSS, and Bulma/Buefy, and we value your framework familiarity and recommendations for empowering you. Collaboration with Engineering will be vital to finalizing deliverables.

Why You’ll Love Working at FirstIgnite

  • Speed and Innovation: We’re moving quickly and evolving constantly, so you’ll work on fresh, impactful challenges.
  • Collaborative Team: Respect, trust, open communication, and solution-minded teammates.
  • Impactful Work: Your designs will directly impact user experience and product decisions.
  • Opportunity to push modern boundaries in SaaS design and scaling design systems for rapid growth.
  • Design boldly, fail fast, and learn using the latest tools and trends.

What Success Looks Like

  • Designs are implemented with minimal back-and-forth due to clear communication and engineering alignment.
  • Efficient delivery of multiple feature mockups each week aligned with product timelines.
  • Clear, intuitive workflows guiding users toward goals with a strong user experience.
  • A platform design that feels modern, fast, and trustworthy within the SaaS market.

How To Apply

Please include the following: portfolio, resume, and a brief cover letter explaining why you’re excited about FirstIgnite and how your skills will elevate the product.

  • Own the entire content strategy—your ideas actually shape our marketing direction
  • All travel, lodging, food, and expenses covered for Portland content trips
  • Work directly with the founder, no corporate bureaucracy or endless approval chains
  • Steady monthly income in USD while living in your home country
  • Build portfolio with content that drives real business results, not just vanity metrics
  • Creative freedom to develop authentic brand voice that stands out from boring competitors
We're looking for a Content Strategist & Creator who can think strategically AND execute flawlessly. You'll develop our content strategy, travel to Portland to capture authentic footage and photos, write everything from social captions to blog posts, and manage our social media presence. This isn't just posting content—it's building a content machine that drives real business growth.
Responsibilities:
  • Strategic Content Planning - Develop quarterly and monthly content strategies that align with business goals, research competitors, analyze what's working, and plan content calendars that actually drive leads and conversions
  • On-Site Content Creation - Travel to Portland periodically to film real moving jobs, interview customers, capture behind-the-scenes moments, and gather photo/video content that showcases our premium service and authentic brand personality
  • AI Content Writing That Converts - Utilize AI to write compelling social media captions, blog posts, email newsletters, SMS, website copy, and other content that educates prospects and converts them into customers who choose quality over price
  • Social Media Management - Post daily content across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok, engage with followers, respond to comments, and build online community that drives word-of-mouth referrals

Qualifications:
  • Exceptional skills in utilizing AI to generate automation and on brand content without sounding like AI did it
  • Valid US visa and ability to travel freely between your home country and United States
  • 2-3 years experience developing and executing social media strategies that drive actual business results
  • Strong writing skills in English—you can explain complex topics simply and create captions that stop the scroll
  • Experience with content planning, social media scheduling tools, and analytics
  • Comfortable filming video and taking photos on job sites during fast-paced work environments
  • Understanding of Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and TikTok—what works on each platform and why
  • Self-starter who can work independently across time zones without constant hand-holding
  • Bonus points: Experience with service businesses, B2B content, or working with premium brands
What we DON'T want:
  • "Social media managers" who just repost motivational quotes and call it strategy
  • People who think more followers automatically means more business
  • Content creators who need perfect conditions to produce good work
  • Anyone who's never actually tracked how their content impacts business revenue
Compensation: $1,500-1,800 USD monthly rate based on experience and proven track record of driving business results with content strategy.
